_about: Cards Japan has released and the English card list has not. Each new card's text is an unofficial translation of the Japanese card, marked as such on the card. Reprints carry the English card's own text. Remove a set once the English card list has it: the refresh then brings it in with official text.

jp-dzss19.productName: [DZ-SS19] Start Deck "Ghost Meets Gal!" (Japanese, unofficial translation)

[ACT](VC):[D-Legion]"( ´>ㅿ<`;)Ghost meets Gal( ơ ∇く,,) Santi" (If your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, this unit may choose up to two trigger units other than [Heal] and [Over], and cards other than trigger units for a total of four cards from drop once, return them to the deck, search the deck for the specified card, D-Legion, and those cards lose their persona ride icons while they are D-Legion)

cards.name: Road to the Live, Lubna
cards.effect:
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC) by riding from a unit with "Santi" in its card name, draw a card.
[AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks, if your vanguard is grade 3 or greater with "Lubna" in its card name, this unit gets [Power]+5000 until end of that battle, and at the end of that battle, put this unit into soul.
[AUTO](Soul):When your vanguard with "Lubna" in its card name is attacked, [COST][put this card on the bottom of your deck], and that unit gets [Power]+10000 until end of that battle. You cannot pay the costs of [AUTO] abilities in your soul of cards with the same name as this card for that turn.
[Unofficial translation of the Japanese card. The English DZ-SS19 is due 2027-01-22.]

cards.name: Days of Lessons, Santi
cards.effect:
[AUTO]:When this unit is ridden by "Road to the Live, Lubna", choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and retire it. If you did not retire, draw a card.
[ACT](Soul/Drop):If your vanguard is grade 3 with "Lubna" in its card name, and you have not ridden this turn, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & bind this card], search your deck for up to one grade 3 or greater card with "Lubna" in its card name, ride it as [Stand], and shuffle your deck.
[Unofficial translation of the Japanese card. The English DZ-SS19 is due 2027-01-22.]

cards.name: Aiming to Be Idols! Lubna & Santi
cards.effect:
[AUTO]:When this unit is ridden, if you are going second, draw a card.
[Unofficial translation of the Japanese card. The English DZ-SS19 is due 2027-01-22.]

cards.name: ( ´>ㅿ<`;)Ghost meets Gal( ơ ∇く,,) Santi
cards.effect:
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC) or (RC), if your vanguard has "Lubna" in its card name, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and perform one of the following. If this unit was placed on (VC), you do not need to pay the cost.
・Choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and retire it.
・If it is not your battle phase, look at the top seven cards of your deck, choose up to one card with grade less than or equal to your vanguard's grade from among them, call it to (RC), and shuffle your deck.
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, if your vanguard is [D-Legion], all of your front row rear-guards get [Power]+5000 until end of turn. Then, if this is the second battle this unit has performed this turn, [COST][Energy-Blast 3], choose a card from your hand, call it to a front row (RC), and it gets [Power]+10000 until end of turn. If this unit [D-Legion] this turn, choose one of your units in the same column as the called unit, and [Stand] it.
[CONT](RC):If your vanguard is grade 3 or greater with "Lubna" in its card name, this unit gets [Power]+5000.
[Unofficial translation of the Japanese card. The English DZ-SS19 is due 2027-01-22.]

cards.name: Find the Scoop! Aido
cards.effect:

[CONT](RC):If your vanguard has "Lubna" or "Santi" in its card name, this unit gets "Boost", and can intercept from the back row.
[Unofficial translation of the Japanese card. The English DZ-SS19 is due 2027-01-22.]

cards.name: Deadly Boot Camp, Sergeant Serjean
cards.effect:

Then, if your vanguard is grade 3 or greater, choose one of your units with "Lubna" or "Santi" in its card name, and it gets [Power]+5000 until end of turn.
[AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks, if your vanguard is grade 3 or greater, this unit gets [Power]+5000 until end of that battle.
[Unofficial translation of the Japanese card. The English DZ-SS19 is due 2027-01-22.]

・[Energy Charge](2).

jp-dzbt17-varga.productName: [DZ-BT17] Booster "Destined Star Battle" -- Varga cards (Japanese, unofficial translation)

cards.name: Unparalleled Drekasleif, Varga Dragres "Tensei"
cards.effect:
[CONT]:This card is a persona ride when it is normal ridden from a grade 3 with "Varga" in its different card name, and when it is normal ridden upon.
[ACT](VC)[1/Turn]:[COST][bind a card with "Varga" in its card name from your hand or soul], choose up to two cards without "[CONT]:Sentinel" with different grades from your drop whose total grade is less than or equal to the number of cards in your damage zone, and call them to (RC).
[AUTO](VC)[1/Turn]:When this unit attacks a vanguard, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], retire all of your front row rear-guards, and this unit gets [Power]+10000 until end of turn. At the end of that battle, [Stand] this unit, it gets [Power]+5000/drive -2 until end of turn, and if your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, all of your front row rear-guards get [Power]+5000 until end of turn.
[Divine Skill] - [AUTO](VC):At the end of the battle this unit attacked a grade 3 or greater unit, if this unit has attacked two or more times this turn, and your or your opponent's damage zone has four or more cards or you persona rode this turn, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], [Stand] this unit, and its drive becomes 2 until end of turn.
[Unofficial translation of the Japanese card. The English DZ-BT17 is not out yet.]

cards.name: Dragritter of Ember Blossoms, Shuura
cards.effect:
[AUTO]:When this card is discarded from hand during your turn, you may choose a grade 3 card with "Varga" in its card name from your ride deck, and reveal it. If you revealed a card, or you have a grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Varga" in its card name, [COST][Soul-Blast 1 or Energy-Blast 3], and draw a card.
[CONT](RC):If you have a grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Varga" in its card name, this unit gets [Power]+5000. (Active on opponent's turn too)
[AUTO]:When this unit is retired from (RC) by the ability of your grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Varga" in its card name, if your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, and all of your rear-guards have card names different from this card, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 or Energy-Blast 3], call this card to (RC), and it gets [Power]+10000 until end of turn.
[Unofficial translation of the Japanese card. The English DZ-BT17 is not out yet.]

cards.name: Dragritter, Nabiila
cards.effect:
[AUTO]:When this card is discarded from hand during your turn, you may put this card into soul.
[AUTO](Drop):When your grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Varga" in its card name is attacked, [COST][bind this card], and that unit gets [Power]+10000 until end of that battle. For that turn, you cannot bind cards with the same name as this card from your drop.
[Unofficial translation of the Japanese card. The English DZ-BT17 is not out yet.]

cards.name: Boulderaxe Dragon "Fugen"
cards.effect:
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by a grade 3 card with "Varga" in its card name, call this card to (RC), choose one of the [AUTO] abilities your vanguard originally has, and the next [Counter-Blast] you pay for its cost this turn is reduced by 1.
[AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks a vanguard, if you have a grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Varga" in its card name, this unit gets [Power]+5000 until end of that battle, and at the end of that battle, retire this unit, and draw a card. (This effect is mandatory)
[Unofficial translation of the Japanese card. The English DZ-BT17 is not out yet.]

cards.name: Blazezanber Dragon "Touen"
cards.effect:
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by "Boulderaxe Dragon "Fugen"", call this card to (RC), and [Soul-Charge 1].
[CONT](RC):During your turn, if you have a grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Varga" in its card name, this unit gets [Power]+2000.
[AUTO]:When this unit is retired from (RC) by the ability of your vanguard with "Varga" in its card name, [COST][Soul-Blast 1], and put this card into your hand.
[Unofficial translation of the Japanese card. The English DZ-BT17 is not out yet.]

cards.name: Festival Cannon Dragon, Dinofest
cards.effect:
[AUTO](RC):When this unit boosts, if your vanguard is grade 3 or greater, and there are none of your opponent's rear-guards in the same column as this unit, this unit gets [Power]+5000 until end of that battle.
[AUTO](RC):At the end of the battle this unit boosted, if you have more rear-guards than your opponent, or your opponent's rear-guard was retired this turn, [COST][bind this unit], look at the top five cards of your deck, choose up to one grade 2 or greater unit card, or <Dino Dragon> normal unit without "[CONT]:Sentinel" with a card name different from this card, from among them, reveal it and put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
[Unofficial translation of the Japanese promo D-PR/1386, which has no English printing yet.]

jp-pr-bad-spiral.productName: [D-PR] Promo "Star-vader, Bad Spiral Dragon" (Japanese, unofficial translation)

cards.name: Star-vader, Bad Spiral Dragon
cards.effect:
[AUTO]:When this card is discarded from hand during your turn, if your vanguard has "Star-vader" in its card name, look at the top seven cards of your deck, choose up to one card with "Star-vader" in its card name from among them, reveal it and put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
[ACT](Drop):If your vanguard is grade 3 or greater with "Star-vader" in its card name, and your opponent has one or less locked cards, [COST][bind this card], choose up to one unit card from your opponent's drop, and your opponent calls it to (RC). The [AUTO] abilities of your opponent's card do not activate from this call.
[Unofficial translation of the Japanese promo D-PR/1862, which has no English printing yet.]
